description: Expander that drives Conductor from control voltages, offering three ways of choosing a pattern: a knob-like voltage, a pair of up and down triggers, or mapped notes

params.text: Chooses how CV 1 is read: Index takes a voltage across the whole pattern range, Scroll takes triggers that step up and down, Note Map takes volt-per-octave notes mapped by hand
Enters mapping mode, where the pattern Conductor has selected is attached to the note at CV 1 the next time a gate arrives; pressing again switches to unmapping, and again returns to playing

inputs.text: In Index mode a voltage from 0V to 10V picks a pattern from the first to the last; in Scroll mode a rise past 2V steps the selection up; in Note Map mode it takes the note to be mapped
In Scroll mode a rise past 2V steps the selection down; in the other two modes this jack does nothing
A rise past 2V queues the selected pattern in Conductor, or takes it out of the queue if it was already there

notes: the module has to be placed touching the right-hand side of Conductor or of another Conductor expander; anywhere else it does nothing
the upper display reads the pattern this expander has selected and the lower one the pattern queued in Conductor
in Note Map mode the incoming pitch is quantised to 24 steps per octave before it is looked up, and the MAP button lights blue while mapping and red while unmapping
every jack is monophonic, whatever is patched in
menu: Clear mappings — throws away every note-to-pattern mapping made in Note Map mode

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
